# fjordrun_service (Resource)

A service: `web`, `worker`, `cron`, `database` or `agent`, from a GitHub repository, a container image, or nothing yet. Functions have their own resource, `fjordrun_function`.

**Environments.** A service exists in every environment of its project, with settings per environment. This resource creates the service and manages its settings in one environment, `environment_id`. At creation every environment gets the same configuration; afterwards a change here only applies to `environment_id`. Manage the settings in other environments with `fjordrun_service_environment`. Destroying this resource deletes the service in all environments.

**Deployments.** By default this resource deploys when it is created and when it changes. For one rollout per apply, after variables, volumes and the rest are in place, set `auto_deploy = false` and use a `fjordrun_deployment` with `config_hash` as one of its triggers.

**Partial configuration.** The API merges what you set with defaults for the kind. Fields you leave out take the API's value and aren't a diff. Removing a field from the configuration keeps its current value; to clear a string field, set it to `""`.

~> Deleting a service deletes its volumes and their data. Protect databases with `lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "team_id" {
  type = string
}

resource "fjordrun_project" "shop" {
  team_id = var.team_id
  name    = "shop"
}

# A web service from GitHub. What you leave out of build, deploy and resources takes the API's defaults.
resource "fjordrun_service" "web" {
  project_id     = fjordrun_project.shop.id
  environment_id = fjordrun_project.shop.default_environment_id
  name           = "web"
  kind           = "web"

  source = {
    type     = "github"
    repo     = "acme/shop"
    branch   = "main"
    root_dir = "apps/web"
  }

  build = {
    builder     = "dockerfile"
    watch_paths = ["apps/web/**"]
  }

  deploy = {
    port             = 3000
    replicas         = 2
    healthcheck_path = "/health"
  }

  resources = {
    cpu_millicores = 1000
    memory_mb      = 1024
  }
}

# A worker from an image.
resource "fjordrun_service" "worker" {
  project_id     = fjordrun_project.shop.id
  environment_id = fjordrun_project.shop.default_environment_id
  name           = "worker"
  kind           = "worker"
  source         = { type = "image", image = "ghcr.io/acme/worker:1.4" }
  deploy         = { start_command = "./worker --queue default" }
}

# A nightly job.
resource "fjordrun_service" "cleanup" {
  project_id     = fjordrun_project.shop.id
  environment_id = fjordrun_project.shop.default_environment_id
  name           = "cleanup"
  kind           = "cron"
  source         = { type = "image", image = "ghcr.io/acme/cleanup:1.0" }
  deploy         = { cron_schedule = "0 3 * * *" }
}

# A database from your own image. A template (fjordrun_template_deployment) brings passwords and a volume with it.
resource "fjordrun_service" "db" {
  project_id     = fjordrun_project.shop.id
  environment_id = fjordrun_project.shop.default_environment_id
  name           = "db"
  kind           = "database"
  source         = { type = "image", image = "postgres:17" }
  deploy         = { port = 5432 }

  lifecycle {
    # deleting a service deletes its volume and data
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

# Nothing runs until a deployment.
# Pair with auto_deploy = false on the provider or the service, or a change deploys twice.
resource "fjordrun_deployment" "web" {
  service_id     = fjordrun_service.web.id
  environment_id = fjordrun_service.web.environment_id
  wait           = true
  triggers       = { config = fjordrun_service.web.config_hash }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) The environment whose settings this resource manages.
- `name` (String) Service name (1-100 characters, unique in the project). Other services refer to it in `${{Name.VAR}}` references.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID.

### Optional

- `auto_deploy` (Boolean) Deploy when this resource is created or changes. Leave out to use the provider's `auto_deploy` (default `true`). With `false` the change is saved and goes live with the next deployment, which `fjordrun_deployment` makes explicit.
- `billing_granularity` (String) Billing granularity: `second`, `minute` or `hour`.
- `build` (Attributes) How the image is built (GitHub sources). Fields you leave out keep the value the API has. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--build))
- `canvas` (Attributes) Position on the project canvas. Assigned automatically if left out. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--canvas))
- `deploy` (Attributes) How the service runs. Fields you leave out keep the value the API has (its default for the service's kind, at first). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deploy))
- `icon` (String) Icon name (up to 100 characters).
- `kind` (String) `web` (default), `worker`, `cron`, `database` or `agent`. Changing it replaces the service.
- `resources` (Attributes) CPU and memory limits. Your plan's limits apply. Fields you leave out keep the value the API has. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))
- `source` (Attributes) Where the code or image comes from. Leave out for an empty service. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source))

### Read-Only

- `config_hash` (String) Digest of the source and configuration in `environment_id` as the API holds them. Use it as a `fjordrun_deployment` trigger.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `id` (String) Service ID.
- `private_hostname` (String) Hostname reachable from the other services of the environment.
- `private_hostnames` (List of String) The short hostname, then the project-qualified one that services of other projects in the same private network use.
- `slug` (String) URL-safe name, used in hostnames.
- `status` (String) Status in `environment_id`: `inactive`, `building`, `deploying`, `active`, `sleeping`, `stopped`, `failed`, `crashed` or `removed`.

<a id="nestedatt--build"></a>
### Nested Schema for `build`

Optional:

- `build_command` (String) Build command. An empty string clears it.
- `builder` (String) `auto` (repository Dockerfile, else detection, else Nixpacks), `nixpacks` or `dockerfile`.
- `dockerfile_path` (String) Path of the Dockerfile. An empty string clears it.
- `watch_paths` (List of String) Only pushes touching these paths deploy (up to 50).


<a id="nestedatt--canvas"></a>
### Nested Schema for `canvas`

Optional:

- `x` (Number) Horizontal position. Set both or none.
- `y` (Number) Vertical position. Set both or none.


<a id="nestedatt--deploy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deploy`

Optional:

- `cron_schedule` (String) Cron expression (kind `cron`). An empty string clears it.
- `healthcheck_path` (String) HTTP path of the health check, starting with `/`. An empty string turns the check off.
- `healthcheck_timeout` (Number) Seconds a new deployment has to become healthy (10-3600).
- `max_restarts` (Number) Restarts allowed before the deployment counts as crashed (0-100).
- `port` (Number) Port the service listens on (1-65535).
- `replicas` (Number) Number of replicas (0-50; your plan's limit applies). 0 stops the service.
- `restart_policy` (String) `on_failure`, `always` or `never`.
- `sleep_after_minutes` (Number) Minutes without requests before sleeping (1-1440).
- `sleep_when_idle` (Boolean) Scale to zero after a while without requests, and wake on the next one.
- `start_command` (String) Command to start the service. An empty string clears it.


<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Optional:

- `cpu_millicores` (Number) CPU limit in millicores (100-64000).
- `memory_mb` (Number) Memory limit in MB (128-131072).


<a id="nestedatt--source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source`

Optional:

- `branch` (String) Branch to build (type `github`). Leave out for the repository's default branch.
- `image` (String) Container image reference (type `image`).
- `repo` (String) `owner/name` of the GitHub repository (type `github`).
- `root_dir` (String) Directory in the repository to build from (type `github`).
- `type` (String) Required when `source` is set: `github`, `image` or `empty`. `template` only describes a service adopted from a template.

Read-Only:

- `template` (String) The template the service came from, if any.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# service_id/environment_id
terraform import fjordrun_service.web 77777777-7777-7777-7777-777777777777/66666666-6666-6666-6666-666666666666
```
